description: Build a PyPI discovery paginator daemon as a third discovery source beyond npm + github. Search PyPI JSON API for keywords mcp-server, model-context-protocol, mcp-tools. Paginate 5 pages of 100 per 600s cycle. Insert candidates into mcp_discovery_candidates via WriteService ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. server_id = blake2s('pypi:' + name).hexdigest()[:16]. Logs FileHandler only. ISO 8601 timestamps. Rate limit 60 calls/min.
